semantic_scope.notes: These points locate two archaeological/archive contexts relevant to the broad Pylos/Knossos evidence package. They do not define Mycenaean territorial extent and must not be rendered as a filled practice polygon.

loci.locus_canonical_name: Palace of Nestor / Pylos archaeological locus
loci.resolution_method: Wikidata CC0 point for the enduring archaeological site of the Palace of Nestor (ancient Pylos). Used only as an evidence-locus locator for the Mycenaean evidence package; not a polity boundary or practice extent.

source.title: Palace of Nestor (Q2047396)
source.geographic_scope: Palace of Nestor / ancient Pylos archaeological site, Messenia, Greece
source.temporal_scope: Modern coordinate for enduring archaeological site; Mycenaean use bounded here to approximately 1300–1200 BCE
source.independence_notes: Geometry-only locator. It is independent of the historical labour-status classification and must not be counted as historical evidence for slavery/dependency.
source.reliability_limitations: Coordinate is a modern archaeological-site locator imported into Wikidata; it does not define the historical settlement, palace domain, polity boundary or territorial extent.

version.redistribution_status: coordinate and entity ID may be redistributed under CC0

loci.resolution_method: Wikidata/Nomisma-supported CC0 point for the enduring Knossos archaeological site. Used only as an evidence-locus locator for the Mycenaean evidence package; not a territorial boundary or practice extent.

source.title: Knossos (Q173527)
source.temporal_scope: Modern coordinate for enduring archaeological site; Mycenaean archive context bounded here to approximately 1450–1300 BCE
source.independence_notes: Geometry-only locator. The precise coordinate has Nomisma references in the pinned Wikidata revision; it is independent of the labour-status classification.
source.reliability_limitations: Point locates the archaeological site and does not define the Bronze Age city, palace territory, political boundary or territorial extent.

version.redistribution_status: coordinate and entity ID may be redistributed under CC0

qc.visual_rule: Point loci only; no fill, polygon union, buffer or inferred corridor.
